findings.claim: STM 20-F 風險因子載明：美中關稅、出口限制與實體清單已限制或可能限制其與部分中國客戶／供應商交易；並點名美國威脅的 100% 晶片關稅與中國相關出口管制。
findings.excerpt: In addition, we may be subject to the imposition of sector-specific tariffs, such as the 100% tariff on imported, foreign-produced semi-conductor chips threatened by the current U.S. administration, or China’s related export controls.

findings.claim: 20-F 載明 2025 年 4 月美國商務部啟動半導體及設備進口的 Section 232 國安調查，可能帶來額外關稅與貿易限制。
findings.excerpt: For example, in April 2025, the Department of Commerce launched an investigation into the national security impacts of imported semiconductors and semiconductor manufacturing equipment. This investigation may result in additional tariffs and trade restrictions that may adversely impact the semiconductor industry and our business.

findings.claim: 公司 2026 Q1 財測未計入全球關稅潛在進一步變動的影響。
findings.excerpt: This business outlook does not include any impact from potential further changes to global trade tariffs compared to the current situation

findings.claim: 2026-01-14 總統公告對特定先進半導體課 25% Section 232 關稅，範圍狹窄，工業等用途有豁免；是否涵蓋 STM 產品未見來源。
findings.source: White & Case: narrowly targeted 25% Section 232 tariff

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋未找到 STM 特定受 Section 232 25% 先進晶片關稅影響的來源；僅有一般法律事務所摘要，故未入 finding。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
